title: Ay Nana Teri Ummat se
body:
ay nana teri ummat se tera deen bacha kar laayi hai
teri beghar zainab aayi hai
o teri beghar zainab aayi hai
be-chadar zainab aayi hai
tera deen bacha kar laayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha jo kisi ne zainab se bhai hai kahan to zainab ne
ek muthi khaak uthayi hai aur khaak hawa may udayi hai
teri be-ghar zainab aayi hai
ay nana teri ummat se…
<<DIVIDER>>
quran tha jo shabbir ka tan maqtal may sumon se rondha gaya
juz daan tha jo tan ka kurta wo khoon may dooba laayi hai
teri be-ghar zainab aayi hai
ay nana teri ummat se…
<<DIVIDER>>
be-jaan hujre chup darwaze saabit parde be-jumbish lab
ya ghar may hai ek sannata ya zainab ki tanhai hai
teri be-ghar zainab aayi hai
ay nana teri ummat se…
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal may lagi thi keemat e deen boli dete thay dushmane deen
ay nana maine keemat e deen apni chadar se chukayi hai
teri be-ghar zainab aayi hai
ay nana teri ummat se…
<<DIVIDER>>
tha jisne sawaar karaya jab zainab ki sawari nikli thi
ay shehre madina kahan hai wo zainab ki sawari aayi hai
teri be-ghar zainab aayi hai
ay nana teri ummat se…
<<DIVIDER>>
us chadar se hi kaabe ki hurmat ka banega ghilaaf naved
bhai par se sadqa karke jo chadar zainab aayi hai
teri be-ghar zainab aayi hai
ay nana teri ummat se…
author: Ahmed Naved
